name: bcm-dashboards
description: Amazon Web Services Billing and Cost Management Dashboards is a service that enables you to create, manage, and share dashboards that combine multiple visualizations of your Amazon Web Services cost and usage data.

subcommands.name: create-dashboard
subcommands.description: Creates a new dashboard that can contain multiple widgets displaying cost and usage data.

subcommands.name: create-scheduled-report
subcommands.description: Creates a new scheduled report for a dashboard.

subcommands.name: execute-scheduled-report
subcommands.description: Triggers an immediate execution of a scheduled report, outside of its regular schedule.

subcommands.name: get-dashboard
subcommands.description: Retrieves the configuration and metadata of a specified dashboard, including its widgets and layout settings.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the resource-based policy attached to a dashboard, showing sharing configurations and permissions.

subcommands.name: get-scheduled-report
subcommands.description: Retrieves the configuration and metadata of a specified scheduled report.

subcommands.name: list-dashboards
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all dashboards in your account.

subcommands.name: list-scheduled-reports
subcommands.description: Returns a list of scheduled reports in your account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all tags associated with a specified dashboard resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or updates tags for a specified dashboard resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes specified tags from a dashboard resource.

subcommands.name: update-dashboard
subcommands.description: Updates an existing dashboard's properties, including its name, description, and widget configurations.

subcommands.name: update-scheduled-report
subcommands.description: Updates an existing scheduled report's properties, including its name, description, schedule configuration, and widget settings.
